attributeDescription: Minimum number of units you want customers to buy
Door Type refers to the style or configuration of doors, if present, on the shoe rack, including hinged doors, sliding panels, or no doors.
Brand refers to the name of the company under which the product is marketed and sold.
Height refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot.
qualifierDescription: Height - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the height. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Material Subtype refers to the specific type of material used in constructing the shoe rack, such as wood, metal, or plastic.
allowedValues: Acacia||Acrylic||Aluminium||Ash||Babul||Bamboo||Beech||Brass||Bronze||Cane||Carbon Steel||Cast Iron||Cedar Pine||Cherry Hardwood||Chestnut||Copper||Ebony||Fir||Galvanised Steel||HDF||High Density Block Board||Mahogany||Mango Wood||MDF||MFB||Oak & Birch||Particle Board||PC||Plastic||Plywood||Poplar||PP||Rattan||Rosewood||Rubber Wood||Satinwood||Stainless Steel||Sycamore||Teak||Walnut||Wicker||Wrought Iron

attributeDescription: Portable refers to the ability of the shoe rack to be easily moved or transported, providing flexibility and convenience in usage.
Strain Resistant refers to the shoe rack's ability to withstand pressure or stress without deformation or damage.
Warranty Service Type refers to a brief description on the type of service available from Manufacturer as part for this Warranty.
Pack of refers to the total number of main products that are included by the brand in the package.
Moisture Resistant refers to the shoe rack's ability to repel moisture or resist water damage, ensuring longevity and durability.
Shelf Material refers to the substance used to construct the shelves of the shoe rack, determining their strength, durability, and suitability.
Rack Type refers to the configuration or style of the shoe rack, determining its suitability for different spaces and shoe types.
Other Dimensions refer to any additional information on the dimensions of the product that would be useful to a customer.
exampleValue: 15 x 10 x 18 inches||12 x 8 x 16 inches

attributeDescription: Suitable For refers to the specific use or environment for which the shoe rack is designed, ensuring it meets customers' needs and preferences.

Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Makro website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.
Lock Provided refers to whether the shoe rack is equipped with a locking mechanism to secure its contents, preventing unauthorized access.
Seating Provided refers to whether the shoe rack includes built-in seating or bench functionality for added convenience.
Finish refers to the surface treatment or coating applied to the shoe rack, enhancing its appearance and protecting it from wear and tear.
Packaging Type refers to the specific form of packaging used to protect and present the product.
Number of Drawers refer to the quantity of drawers integrated into the shoe rack, offering additional storage space for organizing footwear.
Weight refers to the weight of the product only, without packaging.
qualifierDescription: Weight - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the weight. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Adjustable Racks refer to shelves or compartments within the shoe rack that can be customized to accommodate different shoe sizes or configurations.
Adjustable Height refers to the capability of the shoe rack's shelves or components to be raised or lowered to accommodate different items.
Other Body and Design Features refer to additional characteristics and aesthetic details of the shoe rack beyond its basic functionality.
Please write a few lines describing your product. Description is limited to 5000 characters (including spaces). It should not include any hyperlinks, additional offers, or promotion text.
exampleValue: Offering a sleek and space-saving solution for organizing your footwear collection. With customizable features and durable construction, it effortlessly blends style with functionality to keep your shoes neatly stored and easily accessible.

attributeDescription: Colour refers to the shade of the product as mentioned by the brand on the label or sales package. The value 'Multicolour' should be used if the product has a mix of colours that is 3 or more prominent colours on the product.
Material refers to the substance from which the shower head is constructed, determining its durability, appearance, and resistance to corrosion.
Delivery Condition refers to the state or condition in which the shoe rack is delivered to the customer, including assembly requirements.
Finish Type refers to the specific method or process used to achieve the desired surface finish on the shoe rack, such as painting or staining.
Recessed Area refers to the indented or lowered section of the shoe rack's surface, providing a designated space for specific items.
Other Features refer to any additional information on the features of the product that would be useful to a customer.
Number of Shoe Pairs refer to the maximum quantity of footwear that can be accommodated by the shoe rack, indicating its capacity.
Number of Ducts refer to the quantity of ventilation openings or channels incorporated into the shoe rack for air circulation.
Number of Shelves refer to the quantity of horizontal platforms or tiers available for storing shoes, indicating the rack's storage capacity.
EAN refers to the 13 digits unique bar code given to each product which is universally recognizable.
Model Number refers to the number assigned by the manufacturers to identify different products that they offer.
Foldable refers to whether the shoe rack can be collapsed or folded for easy storage when not in use.
Is Fragile refers to whether the shoe rack is susceptible to damage, indicating the need for careful handling and maintenance.
Depth refers to the distance from the front to the back of the product.
qualifierDescription: Depth - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the depth. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of the product.
qualifierDescription: Width - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the width. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Warranty Summary refers to a brief description on the warranty details of the product. Mostly one-lined information, this should compulsorily have the number of years covered in warranty and the type (domestic or international) of warranty.
Wall Mount Support refers to the capability of the shoe rack to be securely mounted on a wall, optimizing space utilization.
Water Resistant refers to the ability of the shoe rack to withstand exposure to moisture without damage, preserving its integrity.
Finish Colour refers to the colour or shade of the surface treatment applied to the shoe rack, enhancing its aesthetic appeal.

Sales Package gives the information of all the contents that are sold in the package. Please specify the package information along with the number of each content mentioned before the name. Data should be double pipe (||) separated.
Design refers to the aesthetic appearance and overall structure of the shoe rack, including shape, colour, material, and decorative details.
Rust Proof refers to the resistance of the shoe rack against corrosion or rust formation, particularly in humid environments.
Dust Resistant refers to the ability of the shoe rack to resist dust accumulation, keeping footwear clean and maintaining a tidy storage space.
Maximum Compatible Shoe Size (UK) refers to the largest shoe size that the rack can accommodate comfortably.
Certifications refer to a document prepared by a notified body that describes and validates the authenticity and key characteristics of a product.
Care Instructions refer to guidelines provided by the manufacturer on how to clean and maintain the shoe rack for its longevity and performance.
exampleValue: Vacuum with brush attachment||Wipe clean with a damp cloth
